title: A gift for my granddaughter
text: A gift for my granddaughter. My granddaughter wanted stickers of these specific characters to decorate her clarinet case. I ordered this set and she was over the moon. She has plenty to decorate everything a 12 year old wants to decorate and look cool.  She's loving it. It's much nicer and much more than what she expected.
